guides.title: ElevenLabs TTS · Connection
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.
learning_outcomes: Enter the API key and test it

steps.title: Read connection status and requirements
steps.body: Read Status, API key and Base URL before making changes. If you intend to configure the service, put credentials in its protected key field and use Check connection deliberately. Read the reported result: credentials, endpoint or network availability can each cause a failure. A successful check is not yet a speech test.

steps.title: Recognize a failed connection check
steps.body: If Check connection fails, remove trailing whitespace from the key, then retry once. A repeated failure points to an invalid or expired key rather than a Voice or Delivery problem. Confirm Base URL was not changed from its default before suspecting the account.

learning_outcomes: Refresh the model and voice lists

steps.title: Refresh the model and voice lists
steps.body: On the Voice tab, choose Model first, then click Refresh models if the list is stale. After a valid model is chosen, click Refresh voices and pick Voice from the returned list. A voice list populated against one model may not be valid for another; refresh after changing models.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Set the language code deliberately
steps.body: Language code narrows how the chosen voice speaks. Leave it blank for the voice’s default language, or set it to match the text you will speak. A mismatched code can produce odd pronunciation rather than an outright error, so test one short line after changing it.

guides.title: ElevenLabs TTS · Delivery
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Balance stability and similarity
steps.body: On Delivery, adjust Stability and Similarity one at a time and listen to the same short line afterward. Higher stability reduces expressive variation; higher similarity pulls closer to the reference voice. Style exaggeration and Speed change expression and pace. Speaker boost lifts volume but can sound louder than other NC audio.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Preview after each delivery change
steps.body: Speak one known sentence after each adjustment so changes are attributable. Large swings in Stability and Style together are hard to diagnose; move one control per pass. Reset values if the voice becomes unintelligible. Delivery changes apply to future speech only.

guides.title: ElevenLabs TTS · Voice tag rules
guides.description: Understand the shared voice-tag rules alongside this TTS provider.

steps.title: Read the default voice guidance
steps.body: Voice tag rules describe how NC interprets voice tags alongside this backend. Read the default guidance before changing it; backend selection and reference-audio selection are separate choices. Keeping the existing rules gives you a known baseline for later speech comparisons.

steps.title: Distinguish rules from actual playback
steps.body: A saved rule expresses how voice tags should be interpreted, not proof that a backend accepted the reference or produced audio. A later controlled spoken reply is needed to verify routing. If output changes unexpectedly, compare the rules with their previous text before changing provider settings.
